description: A client presents pre-2026-07-28 traffic: an Mcp-Session-Id header, a GET to the MCP endpoint for a standalone stream, and Last-Event-ID resumption. A defender that honours these has silently reverted to the older, weaker shape.

fixture.observedBehavior: server opens a standalone SSE stream on GET, mints and echoes a session ID, and resumes from Last-Event-ID

expected.signal: legacy session/stream mechanics accepted under a revision that removed them; answer GET and DELETE with 405, ignore Mcp-Session-Id without minting or echoing one, and ignore Last-Event-ID
expected.rationale: streamable-http §Earlier Streamable HTTP Revisions gives exactly these three behaviors for a server that supports only this revision. HTTP+SSE itself has been Deprecated since 2025-03-26.

benignControl.observedBehavior: server handles a conforming stateless POST

provenance: synthetic — behaviors quoted from streamable-http §Backward Compatibility / §Earlier Streamable HTTP Revisions and the deprecated-features registry
